_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits near the Anxiety-Complacency boundary with flat leg, maxed crowded longs, and no breaker; base rate favors coil continuation over a forced directional call.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial - both anchor current phase at Anxiety; only analyst supplies explicit next rung (Complacency/HOLD); narrative silent on forward
next_move.confirmed_if: fear_greed holds 45-55 and BTC remains inside recent range with 30d momentum stuck mid-30s to mid-50s
next_move.invalidated_if: fear_greed breaks under 39 with 30d momentum under 35, or etf_flows rebound above 40 as price reclaims the 30d high
